name: Dibang

source.name: Dri stream, near Keya Pass, Indo-China border

significance: right-bank tributary that helps form the Brahmaputra near Sadiya
site of the proposed Dibang Multipurpose Project (India's tallest planned dam)
flows through the biodiverse Dibang Valley
did_you_know: The Dibang is one of three rivers — alongside the Lohit and Siang — whose confluence near Sadiya, Assam gives rise to the Brahmaputra itself.
Between Nizamghat and Sadiya the Dibang turns highly braided, with its channel width swinging between 4 and 9 kilometres across the flood season.
